name: Deal to My Heart
source:
By a stroke of luck, you manage to get a job as a casino dealer on Aurum, the newest ship by Durst Cruises, straight out of high school.
On your first day, you have a run-in with the infamous Chad Sterling and watch him win game after game of Blackjack at your table.
The next morning, your boss Morgan discovers that someone cheated on your watch, and unless you can find the culprit, you’ll be fired!
You enlist the help of your friend who works on the ship, Theo, to aid in your investigation, but nothing could prepare you for what you uncover…
translation:
你刚高中毕业，幸运地在杜斯特邮轮最新的船“奥鲁姆”上找到了一份赌场荷官的工作。

第一天上班，你遇见了臭名昭著的查德·斯特林，还看着他在你的赌桌上连赢一局又一局的二十一点。

第二天早晨，老板摩根发现有人在你的值班期间作弊；除非你能找出犯人，否则就会被解雇！

你请船上的朋友西奥帮助调查，但接下来揭开的真相，绝非你能预料……
